text:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick pass on CloudForge co-marketing bundle — QA needed for logos in the Launch Lightbox. Uploaded a zip to Drive: https://drive.google.com/xyz :link:
Alex (Design): Taking a look now. Quick ask — do we need the logo with transparent halo or white pad? CloudForge sent both.
Maya (Marketing): We prefer transparent for our dark hero. For marketplace tile we need a white-background variant. Also need a 16:9 and 4:3 crop.
Alex (Design): Got it. If possible send SVGs. If only PNGs, what's the min size? @cloudforge-points?
CloudForge Rep (CloudForge): Sending SVGs in folder `logos/2026-03`. Also adding a 2000px-wide PNG and a square badge. We own the press rights for co-marketing.
Alex (Design): Thanks. For the lightbox we should do safe zone 24px and no bleed. Proposed specs:
```
- hero: JPG 1600x900, .jpg high-quality
- marketplace-tile: JPG 1200x800
- logo: SVG + PNG 2000x400, PNG @2x for retina
- badge: PNG 400x400
```
Maya (Marketing): Copy check: CTA on the tile should be "Get started with Redwood + CloudForge" or shorten to "Start with Redwood + CloudForge"? Leaning shorter.
Lina (Product): Short is better for tile. Longer CTA okay in case study page.
Sanjay (Legal): Confirming trademark lockup is OK. Need written permission line inserted in the case study footnote: "CloudForge and Redwood logos used with permission." Also, confirm we don't use CloudForge's tagline verbatim.
CloudForge Rep (CloudForge): We approve the lockup wording. Tagline OK to paraphrase.
Alex (Design): One visual note — CloudForge's logomark has a thin stroke that disappears on dark backgrounds; we should use the alternate logomark with fill on dark hero. I'll create both comps.
Maya (Marketing): Also need alt text for accessibility and marketplace metadata. Suggested alt: "Redwood Inference integrating with CloudForge edge GPU platform." Any objections?
Priya (Partnerships): That's fine. For SEO metadata, please add keywords: "Redwood Inference, CloudForge, LLM inference, edge GPU".
Maya (Marketing): I'll draft the case study headline and snippet this afternoon and share.
Alex (Design): Uploaded comps to Drive and left notes on bleed/safe zone. Link: https://drive.google.com/abc :eyes: 
Priya (Partnerships): Thanks all — next steps: Alex finalize assets, Sanjay finalize wording, Maya finalize metadata. Target to hand over to partner tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
CloudForge Rep (CloudForge): Sounds good. We'll sign off once we see final comps.
DesignBot: Asset upload detected: 2026-03-15_cloudforge_comps_v2.zip (4 files)
Maya (Marketing): Received, reviewing now.
